basic_details.job_title: BIRAC Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Senior Consultant, Associate Consultant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC) has released the BIRAC Consultant - Communications and Outreach Recruitment 2026 Notification to fill 2 contractual vacancies for the posts of Senior Consultant - Communications and Outreach and Associate Consultant - Communications and Outreach. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for candidates with a Master's degree in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Communications, or related fields who are interested in science communication and innovation management. qualification.details: Master's degree or equivalent in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Communications, or a related field relevant to science communication or innovation management. PhD or additional qualifications in biotechnology/life sciences preferred.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 20-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BIRAC to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BIRAC Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Consultant - Communications and Outreach posts is 20th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant - Communications and Outreach position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Consultant - Communications and Outreach positions at BIRAC.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree or equivalent in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Communications, or a related field relevant to science communication or innovation management.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs.75,000/- to Rs. 1,25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for BIRAC recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online through the official BIRAC website.

faq.question: Q7. What are the different posts advertised by BIRAC?
faq.answer: BIRAC has advertised for Senior Consultant - Communications and Outreach and Associate Consultant - Communications and Outreach posts.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These are contractual positions.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The positions are based in New Delhi, Delhi.
